places.name: Old Town (Stare Miasto, UNESCO Site)
places.ai_summary: A historic district rebuilt after World War II, featuring cobblestone streets, colorful buildings, and the Royal Castle.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Explore the Royal Castle and enjoy local cafes.

places.name: Royal Castle
places.ai_summary: The former residence of Polish monarchs, now a museum showcasing royal apartments, art collections, and historical artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the castle's history.

places.name: Lazienki Park & Palace on the Isle
places.ai_summary: A sprawling park with a picturesque palace, serene lakes, and lush greenery, perfect for relaxation and exploration.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during spring or autumn.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Chopin Monument and the peacocks roaming the park.

places.ai_summary: A magnificent royal palace with stunning gardens, showcasing the art and architecture of the Polish nobility.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Explore the beautiful gardens and the museum inside the palace.
